rationale: Despite a strong earnings beat, the stock has already gapped down 18% and is trading near the session low with only 27 minutes remaining — any position would be subject to forced market-close liquidation, creating unacceptable slippage risk. Price is at 4.3% of today's range with no clear directional momentum in the last five candles (choppy, overlapping bars), and the broad market is under pressure (SPY -1.31%, VIXY +6%). The risk/reward of entering a volatile, post-gap name this close to the close does not justify commitment.
